statement: For its BLE HID-over-GATT mode, xpadneo sends rumble using a HID output SET_REPORT request on the acknowledged route, while its non-HOGP route sends a HID output report and inserts a delay. This difference can affect whether the consumer actually delivers feedback to an emulated Bluetooth-bus UHID endpoint; delivery has not been exercised here.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
